mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS (TOUR_ID, FIELD_NM, LANG_CD, TRANS_TYPE, SRC_LANG_CD, SRC_HASH, SRC_TEXT, TRANS_TEXT, STATUS_CD) VALUES (#{tourId}, #{fieldNm}, #{langCd}, #{transType}, 'ko', SHA2(TRIM(#{srcText}), 256), TRIM(#{srcText}), #{transText}, 'DONE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SRC_HASH = VALUES(SRC_HASH), SRC_TEXT = VALUES(SRC_TEXT), TRANS_TEXT = VALUES(TRANS_TEXT), STATUS_CD = 'DONE'
mapper.sql: (SELECT t.TRANS_TEXT FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS t WHERE t.TOUR_ID = b.TOUR_ID AND t.FIELD_NM = '${field}' AND t.LANG_CD = '${lang}' AND t.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' AND t.SRC_HASH = SHA2(TRIM(b.${field}), 256) ORDER BY FIELD(t.TRANS_TYPE, 'MANUAL', 'TOURAPI', 'LEGACY', 'AI') LIMIT 1)
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b SET b.TOUR_NM_EN = , b.TOUR_NM_JA = , b.TOUR_CONTENT_EN = , b.TOUR_CONTENT_JA = , b.ROAD_ADDR_EN = , b.ROAD_ADDR_JA = , b.DETAIL_ADDR_EN = , b.DETAIL_ADDR_JA = , b.UPDATE_DT = b.UPDATE_DT
WHERE b.TOUR_ID IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT x.FIELD_NM AS fieldNm, x.TRANS_TEXT AS transText, x.SRC_HASH AS srcHash, x.TRANS_TYPE AS transType FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.FIELD_NM ORDER BY FIELD(t.TRANS_TYPE, 'MANUAL', 'TOURAPI', 'LEGACY', 'AI')) AS rn FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS t WHERE t.TOUR_ID = #{tourId} AND t.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND t.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' AND t.FIELD_NM LIKE CONCAT(#{fieldPrefix}, '%') ) x WHERE x.rn = 1
SELECT LANG_CONTENT_ID FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LANG_MAP WHERE TOUR_ID = #{tourId} AND LANG_CD = #{langCd}

choose.when: SELECT CONTENTTYPEID FROM TB_TRMA_AREA_BASE_EN_API WHERE CONTENTID = #{contentId} LIMIT 1
SELECT CONTENTTYPEID FROM TB_TRMA_AREA_BASE_JP_API WHERE CONTENTID = #{contentId} LIMIT 1
choose.otherwise: SELECT CONTENTTYPEID FROM TB_TRMA_AREA_BASE_API WHERE CONTENTID = #{contentId} LIMIT 1

mapper.select: SELECT TOUR_ID, LANG_CD, CONTENT_ID, CONTENT_TYPE_ID, USE_TIME, REST_DATE, USE_FEE, PARKING, PARKING_FEE, INFO_CENTER, HOMEPAGE, TEL, FETCH_STATUS, FETCH_DT FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_INTRO WHERE TOUR_ID = #{tourId} AND LANG_CD = #{langCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_TOUR_INTRO (TOUR_ID, LANG_CD, CONTENT_ID, CONTENT_TYPE_ID, USE_TIME, REST_DATE, USE_FEE, PARKING, PARKING_FEE, INFO_CENTER, HOMEPAGE, TEL, INTRO_RAW, COMMON_RAW, FETCH_STATUS, FETCH_DT) VALUES (#{tourId}, #{langCd}, #{contentId}, #{contentTypeId}, #{useTime}, #{restDate}, #{useFee}, #{parking}, #{parkingFee}, #{infoCenter}, #{homepage}, #{tel}, #{introRaw}, #{commonRaw}, #{fetchStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CONTENT_ID = VALUES(CONTENT_ID), CONTENT_TYPE_ID = VALUES(CONTENT_TYPE_ID), USE_TIME = VALUES(USE_TIME), REST_DATE = VALUES(REST_DATE), USE_FEE = VALUES(USE_FEE), PARKING = VALUES(PARKING), PARKING_FEE = VALUES(PARKING_FEE), INFO_CENTER = VALUES(INFO_CENTER), HOMEPAGE = VALUES(HOMEPAGE), TEL = VALUES(TEL), INTRO_RAW = VALUES(INTRO_RAW), COMMON_RAW = VALUES(COMMON_RAW), FETCH_STATUS = VALUES(FETCH_STATUS), FETCH_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT TOUR_ID AS tourId, TOUR_NM AS tourNm, ROAD_ADDR AS roadAddr, DETAIL_ADDR AS detailAddr, MAP_X AS mapX, MAP_Y AS mapY FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND MAP_X IS NOT NULL AND MAP_Y IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TOUR_NM, '') IS NOT NULL

SELECT CONTENTID AS contentId, TITLE AS title, ADDR1 AS addr1, ADDR2 AS addr2, MAP_X AS mapX, MAP_Y AS mapY
FROM TB_TRMA_AREA_BASE_EN_API FROM TB_TRMA_AREA_BASE_JP_API
WHERE NULLIF(MAP_X, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(MAP_Y, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TITLE, '') IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_TOUR_LANG_MAP (TOUR_ID, LANG_CD, LANG_CONTENT_ID, MATCH_TYPE) VALUES (#{tourId}, #{langCd}, #{langContentId}, #{matchType}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE LANG_CONTENT_ID = VALUES(LANG_CONTENT_ID), MATCH_TYPE = VALUES(MATCH_TYPE)

choose.when: SELECT OVERVIEW FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CMM_EN_API WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{langContentId} LIMIT 1
choose.otherwise: SELECT OVERVIEW FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CMM_JP_API WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{langContentId} LIMIT 1

mapper.select: SELECT TOUR_CONTENT FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST WHERE TOUR_ID = #{tourId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_TOUR_INFO_AI (TOUR_ID, FIELD_NM, STATUS_CD, INFO_TEXT, SRC_LANG_CD, SOURCE_URL, SOURCE_TITLE, CHECKED_DT) VALUES (#{tourId}, #{fieldNm}, #{statusCd}, #{infoText}, 'ko', #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceTitle}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE STATUS_CD = VALUES(STATUS_CD), INFO_TEXT = VALUES(INFO_TEXT), SOURCE_URL = VALUES(SOURCE_URL), SOURCE_TITLE = VALUES(SOURCE_TITLE), CHECKED_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT TOUR_ID AS tourId, TOUR_NM AS tourNm, ROAD_ADDR AS roadAddr FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST WHERE TOUR_ID = #{tourId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(best = 'MANUAL') AS manual, SUM(best = 'TOURAPI') AS tourapi, SUM(best = 'LEGACY') AS legacy, SUM(best = 'AI') AS ai, SUM(best IS NULL AND NOT hangul) AS noHangul, SUM(best IS NULL AND hangul AND hasAny) AS stale, SUM(best IS NULL AND hangul AND NOT hasAny) AS missing, SUM((best IS NULL) <> (col IS NULL)) AS columnMismatch FROM ( SELECT b.${column} AS col, b.${field} REGEXP '[가-힣]' AS hangul, (SELECT t.TRANS_TYPE FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS t WHERE t.TOUR_ID = b.TOUR_ID AND t.FIELD_NM = #{field} AND t.LANG_CD = #{lang} AND t.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' AND t.SRC_HASH = SHA2(TRIM(b.${field}), 256) ORDER BY FIELD(t.TRANS_TYPE, 'MANUAL', 'TOURAPI', 'LEGACY', 'AI') LIMIT 1) AS best, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS t WHERE t.TOUR_ID = b.TOUR_ID AND t.FIELD_NM = #{field} AND t.LANG_CD = #{lang}) AS hasAny FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b WHERE b.USE_YN = 'Y' AND NULLIF(TRIM(b.${field}), '') IS NOT NULL ) x
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT TOUR_ID, FIELD_NM, LANG_CD, TRANS_TYPE FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS GROUP BY TOUR_ID, FIELD_NM, LANG_CD, TRANS_TYPE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) d

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS t JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b ON b.TOUR_ID = t.TOUR_ID WHERE t.TRANS_TYPE = 'MANUAL' AND t.FIELD_NM = #{field} AND t.LANG_CD = #{lang} AND t.SRC_HASH = SHA2(TRIM(b.${field}), 256) AND NOT (b.${column} <=> t.TRANS_TEXT)
SELECT TRANS_TYPE AS transType, LANG_CD AS langCd, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS GROUP BY TRANS_TYPE, LANG_CD ORDER BY TRANS_TYPE, LANG_CD
SELECT TRIM(b.${field}) AS source, b.${column} AS value FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b WHERE b.TOUR_ID = #{tourId}

SELECT t.TRANS_TYPE AS transType, t.TRANS_TEXT AS transText FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_TRANS t JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b ON b.TOUR_ID = t.TOUR_ID WHERE t.TOUR_ID = #{tourId} AND t.FIELD_NM = #{field} AND t.LANG_CD = #{lang} AND t.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' AND t.SRC_HASH = SHA2(TRIM(b.${field}), 256) ORDER BY FIELD(t.TRANS_TYPE, 'MANUAL', 'TOURAPI', 'LEGACY', 'AI') LIMIT 1
